creator: Alexander Terp
description: Recorded by ec6628ce's key-encoder oracle (corpus/conformance/key-encoder.json), 2026-11-09: under modifyOtherKeys 2, Ctrl+[, Ctrl+Shift+A, F13, F20, F25 and Help encode to empty output at pin 9f9b8d1d. Claude Code runs with modifyOtherKeys 2 on, so if a person's keystrokes reach a pane through this encoder, those keys would send nothing to it. Not checked: whether the shell's real key path goes through the encoder for these keys (Ctrl+[ may arrive as Escape) or whether the empty output is the encoder declining and something else sending the key. vt-1.0.0 changes this output (#14144, #14145, #14146), so look at these six cases first in a_2vgzMmJ4x's diff.
title: Six keys encode to nothing under modifyOtherKeys 2 at the current libghostty pin
